name: Surveillance & Circuit Filter
known_limitations: Official source capture/identity, freshness, effective selection and PIT readiness not implemented in Lite; no absent-data clearance.
notes: Legacy six-gates-production-v1 is selected active V1; this Lite artifact is review-required knowledge only. No authoritative observation, future/stale observation (>4 trading sessions under selected V1 policy), incomplete ASM/GSM/circuit vector, or unresolved configuration => INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

details.purpose: Block restricted instruments using fresh authoritative ASM/GSM/price-band status.

pass_condition.description: Fresh authoritative complete official observation: ASM stage < 2, GSM stage = 0, and circuit limit > 0.05.

fail_condition.description: ASM stage >= 2, GSM stage > 0, or circuit limit <= 0.05.

details.score_interaction: Independent hard admissibility constraint; any score or LLM cannot override.
details.strategy_interaction: No setup/strategy recommendation or order authority.
details.portfolio_context: Instrument-level execution admissibility; no portfolio allocation.
